title: 第5章 废剑第一招第6章 林照雪问案
lines: 子时前，沈照夜到了黑石矿栈。
黑石矿栈在青岳剑院后山之外，离剑院三里地。
夜风从乱石间穿过，远处矿灯一盏接一盏，像半截埋进山里的鬼火。
沈照夜背着照夜断剑，右臂仍垂在身侧。
每走十几步，肩口的伤就会被扯一下。
它像一条细蛇，藏在骨头里，安静时不动，一动就咬他一口。
沈霜今晚的药，压在怀里那块木牌上。
矿栈门口站着一个瘦高男人，披着灰色短袄，手里提一盏油灯。
男人看了一眼：“青岳剑院来的？”
“少一筐，没钱。塌了，伤了，死了，都算你自己的。”
瘦高男人把木牌丢回来。
“签过死伤自负，就别指望矿栈替你收尸。”
灯光照向矿栈深处。那里有一条低矮洞口，被旧木梁撑住。木梁上挂着半截断绳，绳头发黑，像被火燎过。
沈照夜刚要走，身后传来脚步声。
周野扛着一把旧铁镐跑下来。
瘦高男人冷眼看他：“任务堂只记了一个人。”
周野咧嘴：“我胆子小，人多点安心。”
等瘦高男人走远，周野脸上的笑收起来。
“管事换人了。我以前在黑石矿栈干过，夜工归老许管。今晚这个人，我没见过。”
周野把铁镐往肩上一换。
“但你要死，也别死得不明不白。我知道塌洞哪里能踩，哪里不能踩。”
content_en:
Before midnight, Shen Zhaoye arrived at the Black Stone Mine Stack.
The black stone mine stack is outside the back mountain of Qingyue Sword Academy, three miles away from Sword Academy.
The night wind passed through the rocks, and the miner's lamps in the distance were lit one after another, like will-o'-the-wisps half buried in the mountains.
Shen Zhaoye was carrying Zhaoye's Broken Sword on his back, his right arm still hanging by his side.
Every dozen steps I took, the wound on my shoulder would be pulled.
The sword resentment has not disappeared.
It is like a thin snake, hidden in the bones, motionless when quiet, and bites him when it moves.
But he couldn't stop.
Shen Shuang's medicine tonight was placed on the wooden sign in her arms.
Standing at the door of the mining tavern was a tall and thin man wearing a gray short coat and holding an oil lamp in his hand.
"Task card."
Shen Zhaoye handed it over.
The man glanced at him and said, "Are you from Qingyue Sword Academy?"
"Yeah."
"Do you know the rules?"
"Three loads of slag before dawn."
"One basket short, no money. If it collapses, gets injured, or dies, it's all yours."
The tall, lanky man threw the wooden sign back.
"If you sign that you will be responsible for your own casualties, don't expect the mine to collect your bodies for you."
He raised the lamp and pointed: "West Collapse Cave."
The light shines deep into the mine stack. There was a low opening there, held up by old wooden beams. Half of the rope was hung on the wooden beam. The rope was black, as if it had been burnt by fire.
Just as Shen Zhaoye was about to leave, footsteps came from behind.
"Hey, Mortal Bones."
Zhou Ye ran down carrying an old iron pickaxe.
"What are you doing here?" Shen Zhaoye asked.
"I also took the job."
The tall and lanky man looked at him coldly: "There is only one person in the mission hall."
Zhou Ye took out another wooden sign.
"Slag sorting, one penny."
"It's only a penny job, come to the West Cave Cave?"
Zhou Ye grinned: "I'm timid, I feel more at ease when there are more people."
When the tall and thin man walked away, the smile on Zhou Ye's face faded.
"Seriously, this isn't the right place."
"What's wrong?"
"The manager has changed. I used to work at the Blackstone Ore Stack, and the night work was managed by Lao Xu. I have never seen this person tonight."
Shen Zhao looked toward the collapsed cave to the west at night.
"You can go."
Zhou Ye put the pickaxe on his shoulder.
"I'm here even though I'm here."
"People will die."
"Nonsense. In what year does the Blackstone Mine Stack not die?"
Zhou Ye walked to the front.
"But if you want to die, don't die in an unknown way. I know where you can step on the cave and where you can't step on it."
The two entered the west cave.
